Kforce has a client that is seeking a BA/Functional Data Analyst in Tampa, FL.

Summary:
We are seeking an experienced BA/Functional Data Analyst to translate business needs into effective reporting and analytics solutions. This role partners with Finance, Sales, Operations, and other stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze data, build data models, and develop actionable dashboards and reports. The ideal candidate combines strong business analysis skills with hands-on experience in Power BI, Power Query, Excel, and SQL.

Key Responsibilities:
 
  Gather and document reporting and data requirements from business stakeholders 
  Translate business needs into functional reporting and analytics solutions 
  Design and develop Power BI dashboards and reports from scratch 
  Build and maintain data models supporting financial and operational reporting 
  Use Power Query to clean, transform, and combine data from multiple sources 
  Modify and troubleshoot existing SQL queries 
  Analyze revenue, costs, margins, profitability, and operational performance 
  Develop reports that provide actionable insights to Sales, Finance, and leadership 
  Validate requirements and recommend alternatives when requests are not technically feasible or scalable 
  Maintain and enhance existing dashboards, queries, and reporting tools 
  Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reporting integrity 
  Identify opportunities to automate reporting and reduce manual processes 
 
 
  Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or related field preferred 
  Experience in business analysis, functional analysis, data analytics, or reporting 
  Strong hands-on Power BI experience 
  Experience developing dashboards and data models from scratch 
  Experience gathering requirements from business stakeholders 
  Working knowledge of SQL 
  Strong Power Query skills 
  Strong Microsoft Excel skills 
  Strong financial and operational data analysis skills 
  Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities 
  Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities independently 

 
Preferred Qualifications:
 
  Microsoft Dynamics or similar ERP experience 
  Finance or accounting reporting experience 
  Sales, margin, and profitability analysis experience 
  Tableau experience 
  Reporting automation and process improvement experience 

 
Key Skills:
 
  Business Analysis
